title: 340 16.5.5 The information on offenses under the Import & Export (Control) Act, 1947, enforced by the Directorate General of Foreign Trade, for the year 1993, is given in ANNEXURE-XII. 16.5.6 The number of prosecutions launched for tax evasions and other offences as also the number of penalties imposed under section 271(1)(c) by the Department of Revenue under the Central Board of Direct Taxes during the financial year 1993-94 is shown in ANNEXURE-XIII.
